meta.name: to-tickets
meta.description: Break a plan, spec, or the current conversation into a set of tracer-bullet tickets, each declaring its blocking edges, published to the configured tracker (edges as text in one file per ticket locally, or native blocking links on a real tracker).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 拆解方案或讨论为带依赖的任务单
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常把方案或讨论纪要变成任务清单
copy.tagline_en: Turn plans and specs into dependency-aware tickets automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn plans or specs into actionable task lists.

howto.what: 把计划、规格或当前对话拆成一组 tracer-bullet 工单,每张工单标明阻塞它的其他工单,再发布到配置好的跟踪器:本地每张工单一个文件,真实跟踪器上则用原生阻塞链接。
howto.when: 当你给它计划、规格,或引用(规格文件路径、issue 编号或 URL 等)并要求拆成工单时使用;它已禁用模型自动调用,需手动触发。

say.text: 把这个 spec 拆成 tracer-bullet 工单,并标好阻塞关系
say.note: 先给出编号清单,等你确认。

say.text: 这批工单粒度太粗,帮我合并或再拆细一些
say.note: 会调整拆分方案并再次征求确认。

say.text: 把确认后的工单发布到本地 .scratch 目录
say.note: 每张工单写成单独文件,按依赖顺序编号。

howto.what_en: Turns a plan, spec, or the current conversation into tracer-bullet tickets, each listing the tickets that block it, then publishes them to the configured tracker — one local file per ticket, or native blocking links on a real tracker.
howto.when_en: Use when you hand it a plan, spec, or a reference (spec path, issue number or URL) and ask to split the work into tickets. Model invocation is disabled, so it must be invoked manually.

say_en.text: Break this spec into tracer-bullet tickets with blocking edges
say_en.note: You get a numbered list to approve first.

say_en.text: The tickets feel too coarse — merge or split them further
say_en.note: It revises the breakdown and asks again.

say_en.text: Publish the approved tickets to the local .scratch folder
say_en.note: One file per ticket, numbered in dependency order.
